items.label: hypothesis
items.text: analysis (incident.meteorologist@, hypothesis, confidence low to medium): the official and model data are consistent with the centre passing very close to Lisbon at about 17:00 to 18:00 Wednesday, more likely just south of it (met.no's pressure minimum 986.7 hPa at 17:00 to 18:00 and a 160° wind swing in an hour; the guidance has moved). Against: IPMA's red wind unchanged, its track text already includes Lisbon, no communiqué no. 3, point models move. It does not lower the danger: the worst moves toward the passage, about 16:00 to 19:00, and a lull near the centre is not the end. Wednesday tests it: wind backing east then north and pressure near 987 hPa means it passed south

IPMA's orange wind warnings for Madeira's mountain regions say "Rajadas até 130 km/h" (Tuesday 21:00 to Wednesday 00:00, and Wednesday 06:00 to 12:00); the red warning between them said 140 km/h. Observed: the highest mean wind at an IPMA station is 93.2 km/h at Areeiro (the hour labelled 02:00; the stations report no gusts); the highest measured gust is still the airport's 98 km/h at 02:30 (s-1111T0238)

items.label: hypothesis
items.text: analysis (incident.meteorologist@, hypothesis) on the press's "two centres" (s-1111T0939). Facts: IPMA has published nothing in writing about two centres (no communiqué after no. 2, which speaks of one; its CAP texts do not describe the low). Madeira airport's pressure was lowest at 991 hPa at 06:30, its wind swung from south-west to north-east between 07:00 and 08:00, and its pressure is rising again (997 hPa); Lisbon airport's pressure has fallen steadily from 1005 hPa at 04:00 to 1000 hPa at 09:30. Reading (medium confidence): one centre cannot have passed Madeira at 06:30 to 08:00 and reach Lisbon at 13:00 to 15:00, 966 km away, without moving at 140 to 160 km/h, so Madeira's swing was most likely a separate feature: consistent with two centres, not proof of them. The reading of 09:22 stands: a centre close to and just north of Lisbon about 13:00 to 15:00, the strongest wind most likely 14:00 to 16:00. The test: Lisbon's pressure bottoming near 988 to 992 hPa about 14:00 to 15:00, with the wind veering through south-west. Our analysis, not a forecast
